name: Anisotropic Radiative Transfer with SGGX Phase Functions
definition: The anisotropic Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) used to model media with structured micro-geometries (e.g., fabrics, fur), generalizing the standard isotropic RTE by making scattering parameters direction-dependent.
summary: Anisotropic Radiative Transfer with SGGX Phase Functions models structured media like fur using a micro-flake normal distribution that enables fast evaluation and linear interpolation of direction-dependent scattering parameters.
